experiments.scope: The blake3-r2-prefix-v1 target. Each trial executes the search of proof.md 9.1 and 9.8 on the priced instance (flags 3, counter t by step CT): seven outer words from the seed, the test of the work register W against WB; the 39 context lines once and the descriptor table of the masked partner walk; clusters of 32 members (e1 bits 10-14); representative batches 0 to 3 and the last, 32 clusters; per representative the gate words and the gate value, no T2 lookup on a closed gate; per opened cluster the representative's test (2) and paths, the gate state, its units added to W, then five partner batches or the descriptor's two chunks; test (2) on R2 and L2 of the lane; the E lane with its addition to W; at a batch's first E lane the packed Y9 path, cached; T1 of the lane on the cached Y9; a passing lane with the shortcut, the pre-check of 9.7, its addition to W and the preflight of the metered cap CM(T); the metered debit of the executed work; the joint solver of 9.4 with (G7) and (G15) on the source bank and the root predicate; for the first certified root, both last-chunk compressions at counter t and the 256-bit test. Table entries are computed on demand. In the same run every walked member is recomputed straight-line and its omega mod 512 tested against its cluster's two exact prefixes, closed clusters and left-out partners are tested bit by bit for (2), gate values and descriptors against scalar words, T2 entries used bit by bit, every cached Y9 is checked against a fresh fill, every passing lane's words, pre-check and bank against a scalar rebuild and every metered debit against the ledger, every solver call is repeated without G15 with real-compression certificates, every E lane's step-CT message is compressed, and every 8th trial plants a joint root that both traversals must return. The returned pair is built by steps CO and CT on the harness instance (counter 0, flags 11, the c1 forcing t = 0) for the trial's context and first passing member. No BLAKE3 library.
experiments.hypothesis: Each trial's complete 2-round digests (counter 0, flags 11) agree on words 0, 2, 5 and 7 (128 masked bits): after the first half of round 2 only Y3 and Y11 differ; the diagonal step's only differing message word is w5. None enters diagonals 0 and 2. The 16 observations are untrusted program counts, not organizer-recomputed: members (walked), e_lanes (test-(2) passes), passes, solver_calls, leaves, roots, certified, units (charged machine units), solver_units (node ledger), opened and closed (clusters), skipped_pass (closed/omitted members passing bit-serial (2)), checks, mismatches (one per solver cap overrun, unequal meter/ledger, or differing guard word, bank word or cache entry), fills (packed Y9 built once per batch with an E lane), halted. Expected per trial: 32 clusters, about 41% opened (proved bound 0.4064), about 140 walked members, 53 E lanes in 13 filled batches and 0.9 passes, about 0.28 solver calls per pass, almost always no root; skipped_pass, mismatches and halted 0. Historical participant run of the public base: 3,349 of 8,192 clusters opened, 35,703 members walked, 13,481 E lanes, 3,378 fills, 225 passes, 64 solver calls, no root, 379,077 checks, 0 skipped passes, 0 mismatches. This lane-1 revision was not run locally; unhalted events transfer only by proof.md Section 20's static equivalence. The organizer cannot digest-check the counter instance; the historical run is not attack-cost evidence.
